title: Lakota Plant Relatives
tagline: What our plant relatives are called, how to say it, and what they are for.
intro: Scan a placard in the garden, or choose a plant below, to learn its Lakota name, hear how it is said, and read what it has been used for. If you know something about these plants, please share it with us.
